<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class Owner {
    public public(set) readonly int $x; public public(set) readonly int $y;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 1; $this->y = 2; }
}
$o = new Owner(); $copy = clone($o, ['x' => '3']);
echo $o->x, '/', $copy->x, '/', $copy->x === 3 ? 'int|' : 'wrong|';
try { $copy->y = 4; } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
echo $copy->y;

<?php
class Owner {
    public readonly int $x;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 1; }
    public function copied() { return clone($this, ['x' => 2]); }
}
$o = new Owner();
try { $denied = clone($o, ['x' => 2]); } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
$copy = $o->copied(); echo $o->x, '/', $copy->x;
cases.expected_stdout: Cannot modify protected(set) readonly property Owner::$x from global scope|1/2

<?php
class Owner {
    public public(set) readonly int $x;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 1; }
    public function __clone() { $GLOBALS['leaked'] = $this; }
    public function put() { $this->x = 2; }
}
$o = new Owner();
try { $copy = clone($o, ['x' => 'bad']); } catch (TypeError $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
try { $leaked->put(); } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
echo $o->x, '/', $leaked->x, '/', isset($copy) ? 'bound' : 'gone';

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class Owner {
    public public(set) readonly int $x;
    public public(set) readonly int $y;
    public public(set) readonly int $z;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 1; $this->y = 3; $this->z = 5; }
    public function __clone() { $this->z = 6; echo 'C|', $this->z, '|'; }
}
$original = new Owner(); $other = new Owner();
$copy = clone($original, ['x' => '2', 'y' => '4']);
echo $original->x, '/', $original->y, '/', $original->z, '/',
     $copy->x, '/', $copy->y, '/', $copy->z, '/',
     $other->x, '/', $other->y, '/', $other->z, '|';
try { $copy->z = 7; } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(); }

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class Owner {
    public readonly string $x;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 'seed'; }
    public function __clone() { $GLOBALS['escaped'] = $this; }
    public function copied() { return clone($this, ['x' => new Box()]); }
}
class Box {
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo 'T|';
        try { $GLOBALS['escaped']->x = 'inner'; }
        catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
        return 'outer';
    }
}
$original = new Owner(); $copy = $original->copied();
echo $original->x, '/', $copy->x;
cases.expected_stdout: T|Cannot modify protected(set) readonly property Owner::$x from scope Box|seed/outer

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class Owner {
    public readonly string $x;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 'seed'; }
    public function __clone() { $GLOBALS['escaped'] = $this; }
    public function copied() { return clone($this, ['x' => new Box()]); }
    public function put(string $value) { $this->x = $value; }
}
class Box {
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo 'T|';
        $GLOBALS['escaped']->put('inner');
        try { $GLOBALS['escaped']->put('twice'); }
        catch (Error $e) {
            $trace = $e->getTrace();
            echo $e->getMessage(), '|', $trace[0]['function'], '/',
                 $trace[1]['function'], '/', $trace[2]['function'], '|';
        }
        return 'outer';
    }
}
$original = new Owner(); $copy = $original->copied();
echo $original->x, '/', $copy->x;

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class Owner {
    public readonly string $x;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 'seed'; }
    public function __clone() { $GLOBALS['escaped'] = $this; }
    public function copied() { return clone($this, ['x' => new Box()]); }
    public function put(string $value) { $this->x = $value; }
}
class Box {
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo 'T|';
        Fiber::suspend('pause');
        return 'outer';
    }
}
$original = new Owner();
$fiber = new Fiber(function () use ($original) {
    $copy = $original->copied(); echo $copy->x;
});
echo $fiber->start(), '|';
$escaped->put('inner'); echo $escaped->x, '|';
$fiber->resume();
try { $escaped->put('late'); } catch (Error $e) { echo '|', $e->getMessage(); }

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class Owner {
    public readonly string $x;
    public string $mutable = 'seed';
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 'seed'; }
    public function __clone() { $GLOBALS['escaped'] = $this; }
    public function copied() {
        return clone($this, ['mutable' => 'changed', 'x' => new Box()]);
    }
}
class Box {
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo 'T|';
        unset($GLOBALS['escaped']->mutable);
        return 'outer';
    }
}
$original = new Owner(); $copy = $original->copied();
echo $original->mutable, '/', $copy->x, '/', isset($copy->mutable) ? 'present' : 'gone';

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class Owner {
    public readonly string $x;
    public readonly int $y;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 'seed'; $this->y = 1; }
    public function __clone() { $GLOBALS['escaped'] = $this; }
    public function copied() { return clone($this, ['y' => 2, 'x' => new Box()]); }
    public function putX(string $value) { $this->x = $value; }
    public function putY(int $value) { $this->y = $value; }
}
class BaseBox {
    public function __toString(): string { echo 'T|'; throw new Exception('stop'); }
}
class Box extends BaseBox {}
$original = new Owner();
try { $copy = $original->copied(); }
catch (Exception $e) {
    $trace = $e->getTrace();
    echo $e->getMessage(), '|', $trace[0]['class'], '/',
         $trace[0]['function'], '/', $trace[1]['function'], '|';
}
try { $escaped->putX('late'); } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
try { $escaped->putY(3); } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
echo $original->y, '/', $escaped->y, '/', $escaped->x, '/', isset($copy) ? 'bound' : 'gone';
cases.expected_stdout: T|stop|BaseBox/__toString/clone|Cannot modify readonly property Owner::$x|Cannot modify readonly property Owner::$y|1/2/seed/gone

<?php

class Owner {
    public public(set) readonly int $x;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 1; }
}
$original = new Owner();
$value = '2'; $updates = ['x' => &$value];
try { $copy = clone($original, $updates); }
catch (Error $e) {
    $trace = $e->getTrace();
    echo $e->getMessage(), '|', $trace[0]['function'], '|';
}
unset($value);
$copy = clone($original, $updates);
echo $original->x, '/', $copy->x, '/', ($copy->x === 2 ? 'int' : 'other');
cases.expected_stdout: Cannot assign by reference when cloning with updated properties|clone|1/2/int

<?php
class Owner {
    public readonly string $x;
    public readonly string $y;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 'seed'; $this->y = 'seed-y'; }
    public function __clone() {
        $GLOBALS['escaped'] = $this;
        $GLOBALS['pending'] = new Fiber(static function () { $GLOBALS['escaped']->delayed(); });
        $GLOBALS['pending']->start();
    }
    public function delayed() { $this->x = new PendingX(); }
    public function copied() { return clone($this, ['x' => 'first', 'y' => new BoxY()]); }
}
class PendingX {
    public function __toString(): string { echo 'P|'; Fiber::suspend(); return 'late'; }
}
class BoxY {
    public function __toString(): string { echo 'Y|'; $GLOBALS['pending']->resume(); return 'done'; }
}
$original = new Owner();
$copy = $original->copied();
echo $original->x, '/', $copy->x, '/', $copy->y;
